Runbooks synced into pgvector knowledge base

nodes.label: System architecture (demo system -> platform API -> Kafka -> worker -> OpenSearch -> detector -> Postgres -> AI -> dashboard)
nodes.norm_label: system architecture (demo system -> platform api -> kafka -> worker -> opensearch -> detector -> postgres -> ai -> dashboard)

nodes.label: Results Metrics (lag, time to detect, throughput, accuracy)
nodes.norm_label: results metrics (lag, time to detect, throughput, accuracy)

nodes.label: Rule-based playbook (fallback and baseline)
nodes.rationale: Runs without an API key; three fixed queries and failure patterns ranked by specificity; same verifier.

nodes.label: Retry-storm playbook ranking fix
nodes.rationale: retry-storm was misranked as upstream_errors @ gateway-mock in the 15:20 run; the re-run after the fix scored correct.

nodes.label: Circuit breaker counting provider failures only
nodes.norm_label: circuit breaker counting provider failures only
nodes.rationale: Model misbehaviour is not an outage, so only timeouts, connection errors, 429 and 5xx trip it.

nodes.label: Eval saves after every scenario
nodes.rationale: A full run takes ~100 minutes; nothing measured is lost if interrupted.

nodes.label: Local feature-hashing embeddings (512 dims)
nodes.rationale: Anthropic has no embeddings endpoint; not worth a provider or 100 MB model for seven runbooks.

nodes.label: logs.dlq dead-letter topic
nodes.rationale: Nothing is silently dropped: invalid or rejected records go to DLQ with a reason.

nodes.label: HttpLogExporter
nodes.rationale: The logger is never allowed to break a service: catches errors, bounds buffer, rate-limits warnings.

nodes.label: p99 ingest latency target not met (273 ms at 5k/s)
nodes.norm_label: p99 ingest latency target not met (273 ms at 5k/s)
nodes.rationale: Fixed per-request cost: Docker Desktop network hop plus Kafka acks=all round trip; CPU shared under load.

nodes.label: Idempotency enforced at storage (eventId as _id)
nodes.rationale: At-least-once delivery with exactly-once storage; 409 from OpenSearch counted as duplicate.

nodes.label: Kafka between ingest and indexing
nodes.rationale: 202 after acks=all; producer not idempotent because idempotent mode gave 24 s p99; duplicates removed at storage.

nodes.label: Keep docs in sync rule
nodes.rationale: Owner asked docs stay current; every behaviour change updates docs in the same piece of work.

nodes.label: Platform logs to stdout only
nodes.rationale: Ingesting its own logs would create a feedback loop.

nodes.label: Incident grouping by time window
nodes.rationale: Anomaly joins an open incident with an anomaly in the last 10 minutes; deploys from 30 min before are attached as context, not cause.

nodes.label: Stateless EWMA z-score detection
nodes.rationale: Re-reads last 40 minutes every 15 s; z>=3 plus minimum delta; anomalous points do not update baseline; anomalies unique per service/metric/window.

nodes.label: Metrics computed from logs, not stored
nodes.norm_label: metrics computed from logs, not stored
nodes.rationale: No separate metrics store to keep in sync.

nodes.label: EvidenceLedger
nodes.rationale: Investigator reaches data only through the ledger; every query recorded with exact params as q1, q2, ...

nodes.label: Verifier (re-runs cited queries)
nodes.rationale: Keeps a claim only if its check holds on a fresh re-run; runbooks and past incidents rejected as evidence.

nodes.label: Manual tool-calling loop (not SDK tool runner)
nodes.norm_label: manual tool-calling loop (not sdk tool runner)
nodes.rationale: Must route every call through the ledger, enforce a 14-turn/4-minute budget, and handle submit_findings validation errors.

nodes.label: No made-up confidence numbers (likelihood + rank)
nodes.rationale: Hypotheses carry likelihood and rank; the verifier reorders on contradicting evidence.

nodes.label: CI check job (typecheck, tests, dashboard build)
nodes.norm_label: ci check job (typecheck, tests, dashboard build)

nodes.label: Dashboard: server components fetch, client components act
nodes.norm_label: dashboard: server components fetch, client components act

nodes.label: Dashboard chart rules (one measure per chart)
nodes.norm_label: dashboard chart rules (one measure per chart)

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for log attributes
nodes.norm_label: opentelemetry semantic conventions for log attributes

nodes.label: SimulatedDbPool
nodes.rationale: Behaves like pg.Pool so pool exhaustion is real contention without needing a DB in the demo.

nodes.label: CommonJS, not ESM
nodes.rationale: OpenTelemetry patches http/express by hooking require; CommonJS works without loader flags.

nodes.label: Faults change real code paths
nodes.rationale: Symptoms look like production failures with real stack traces.

nodes.label: Faults invisible in logs (stderr only)
nodes.rationale: Keeps AI evaluation honest: investigator must reason from symptoms.

nodes.label: Typed promoted fields + flat_object attributes
nodes.rationale: Arbitrary attribute keys would conflict under dynamic mapping; strict mapping with typed copies for aggregations.

nodes.label: Infrastructure URLs use 127.0.0.1
nodes.rationale: Another Windows process listened on [::1]; Node resolves localhost to ::1 first.

nodes.label: TypeScript monorepo with npm workspaces
nodes.rationale: Services share log schema and middleware so a log format change is a type error everywhere; tsx runs TS directly with no build step.

nodes.label: Prisma 6, not 7
nodes.rationale: Prisma 7 requires driver adapters and a config file.

nodes.label: Traces used for correlation, not exported
nodes.norm_label: traces used for correlation, not exported
nodes.rationale: Spans exist to propagate trace IDs onto log records; the platform rebuilds requests from logs sharing a trace ID.

nodes.label: Tracing as a separate entry point
nodes.norm_label: tracing as a separate entry point
nodes.rationale: Main index imports Express; tracing must load first so Express is patched, hence import './instrumentation' first.

nodes.label: API process + worker process (modular monolith)
nodes.rationale: API only validates and publishes to Kafka so ingestion stays fast when OpenSearch is slow; worker does indexing and detection.

nodes.label: withStartupRetry startup backoff
nodes.rationale: Containers report healthy before they accept clients.
